evals.prompt: Audit this Rust code for AI slop patterns
evals.expected_output: Identifies specific anti-patterns with named categories (Structural/Surface/Cosmetic) and provides concrete rewrites
assertions: Explains the Rust principle behind each fix

evals.prompt: This code looks AI-generated, can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Runs through code structure, error handling, documentation, and naming anti-pattern checklists
assertions: Uses the Positive Doctrine as a guide

evals.prompt: Why is this verbose? Can you simplify?
evals.expected_output: Identifies over-engineered abstractions, unnecessary wrapper structs, or builder patterns on small structs
assertions: Explains why the simpler version is better
